Hi Martin,

Thanks for checking in. Your order Shop···· is paid, and the Magic Miner 40T on it ships October 31, so your end of October expectation is right.

The unit goes out from our warehouse with the Harlo OS Diagnostics plan on the same order, and you will get a shipping confirmation with tracking by email as soon as the label is printed.

If you want to follow the batch on its way to us in the meantime, you can track it here: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status . It can shift a little as stock moves between warehouses, but that is the date on your order.

Thanks for your patience, and just reply here if you need anything else.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy
